name: moonshadow-blackcat-reslib
description: 月影黑猫资源库：网页、订阅管理与 Windows 桌面端

scripts.desktop:portable: npm run release:check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/package-portable.ps1
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run version:check
scripts.desktop:portable:display: npm run release:check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/package-portable.ps1 -Role display
scripts.desktop:portable:management: npm run release:check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File desktop/package-portable.ps1 -Role management
